text.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

words.gloss_range: exception and restriction particle that completes the prior drowning threat rather than opening an independent clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: unmeasured mercy functioning as the exception's cause or provision
usable provision or enjoyment placed under the same exception

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) makes the ayah begin at a point of dependency: 36:44 is not a new free-standing statement but the exception to the drowning-and-no-rescue frame in 36:43. The particle both interrupts that threat and narrows survival to the paired exception that follows, mercy and provision. Its force is restrictive before it is descriptive: the reader has to carry the previous sentence forward in order to hear why drowning is not executed. The hard opening and the answer to the prior negations in 36:43 make the interruption audible, while local grammar keeps that sound and form as reinforcement of the exception rather than an independent etymological proof.

topics.headline: dependent exception to the prior threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins inside the syntax of 36:43, so the mercy phrase is the required exception to a still-active drowning threat.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly treats the exception as recovering its verbal scope from 36:43, which supports the CRITICAL claim that {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) begins a dependent exception clause.

topics.headline: only route expressed as a paired exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception is not vague relief; it restricts escape to the following paired mercy-and-provision frame.
topics.reason: Local syntax marks the exception and then coordinates the two accusatives under that restricted frame, so the onlyness and paired scope survive.

topics.headline: sound and form reinforce the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word as a sharp boundary marker whose sound and restrictive shape fit the logical turn from negated rescue to exception.
topics.reason: The local role is the exception particle; form and sound may reinforce the boundary, but they should not be made an independent etymological proof beyond the licensed restrictive function.

words.gloss_range: unmeasured mercy from the divine source, functioning as the exception's cause and protective provision before the time-limited benefit is named
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, tenderness, beneficence, kinship bond, and womb or protective enclosure imagery; the local noun selects mercy while allowing protective containment pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: from Us, marking the divine source
usable provision or temporary benefit paired with mercy

words.prose: {{ar:رَحْمَةًۭ}} ({{tr:raḥmatan}}) names the exception as mercy, but its accusative form makes that mercy do grammatical work: it is the cause of non-drowning, and it can also be heard as the state in which deliverance occurs. The indefinite ending keeps the mercy unmeasured even after its source is fixed by {{ar:مِّنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}). The root field lets the mercy feel protective and enclosing, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as mercy rather than a literal womb. It also participates in a local mercy thread (36:45, 36:58) and in a broader narrative pattern of mercy from the divine source (12:111, 18:82, 21:107). The word stands first in the paired outcome, so usable benefit arrives only after mercy has been established as source-marked preservation, and the matching accusative cadence makes that mercy-benefit pair audible before the endpoint phrase closes it.

topics.headline: source fixed before utility appears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is first tied to its divine source before the ayah names any usable benefit.
topics.reason: The prepositional suffix phrase immediately follows the mercy noun and is syntactically tied to it, while the recipients are recovered from the prior discourse.

topics.headline: accusative mercy as cause and state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is not merely named; the form casts it as the operative reason for the exception, with a secondary circumstantial coloring.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the accusative primarily as cause or purpose; the broader accusative role pressure is preserved as secondary rather than replacing the local cause reading.

topics.headline: unmeasured mercy beside bounded benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between mercy left qualitatively unmeasured and benefit that will later receive an explicit endpoint.
topics.reason: The mercy noun and benefit noun share indefinite accusative framing, but only the benefit is directly followed by the governed endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: protective enclosure pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy as active preservation that holds life back from drowning, not as a bare feeling after rescue has happened.
topics.reason: V4 separates the mercy branch and womb branch, so the local noun means mercy; the accepted womb and enclosure evidence survives as image pressure because CRITICAL rows connect it to the ship-survival scene.

topics.headline: local and narrative mercy recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this mercy belongs to a wider Quranic and same-surah mercy pattern rather than appearing as an isolated rescue word.
topics.reason: The same-surah references are concrete, and the supplied formula row names narrative recurrences (12:111, 18:82, 21:107), so the recurrence can survive without governing the local parse.

topics.headline: paired sound and cause-to-benefit order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grammar, order, and sound bind mercy to the following benefit as a paired outcome, with mercy heard first.
topics.reason: The two nouns share accusative indefinite form and are coordinated, supporting the paired cadence and ordered relation without needing to turn the conjunction into a separate causal verb.

words.gloss_range: from Us, a compact prepositional source phrase with definite divine speaker reference

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: usable provision following the source phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) fixes the origin of mercy in the divine speaker. Its compact form joins the source preposition to the first-person plural suffix, so an unmeasured mercy is paired with an identified giver; the source sense can also hint at a granted portion from an inexhaustible origin, while local grammar still selects from-Us as the primary relation. The same speaker who held the power of drowning in 36:43 is now named as the source of mercy, and the phrase stands between mercy and benefit as the pivot that keeps the following provision under that source-marked frame. The doubled n sound gives the source phrase audible weight, and the m/n thread across mercy, source, and benefit ties the middle of the ayah together before the final time phrase.

topics.headline: definite source for unmeasured mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mercy is not abstract or ownerless; its source is grammatically identified before benefit is mentioned.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the suffix governed by the source preposition and ties it to the mercy phrase.

topics.headline: source sense with portion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a hint of granted portion from an inexhaustible source, while the local grammar still selects source as the primary relation.
topics.reason: The local phrase primarily marks origin; the partitive pressure is kept as a bounded nuance rather than a replacement for the source relation.

topics.headline: same speaker turns from threat to mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agency is continuous across the boundary: the one able to drown is also the one from whom mercy comes.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix marks the same speaker role, and the prior ayah supplies the threat frame that makes the reversal visible.

topics.headline: pivot between mercy and benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as a hinge between cause and utility: it directly sources mercy and lets the following provision remain heard under that source.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is syntactically tied to mercy; its extension over benefit is preserved only through coordination and word order, not as direct government.

topics.headline: audible concentration at the source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source phrase carries audible weight in the middle of the ayah, binding mercy, source, and benefit by sound.
topics.reason: The form contains the doubled source-pronoun sound and sits between the two provision nouns, supporting the local sound observation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that binds the second accusative provision to the first under the same exception

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: mercy as the first accusative provision
usable provision as the coordinated second accusative

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) expands the exception from one noun into a pair. It joins the usable provision to the prior mercy under the same restricted frame, so survival is heard as mercy and benefit together. The conjunction itself does not force a causal verb, but the order and the nouns allow the second item to work as mercy's practical expression: mercy first, then provision as what mercy grants for use.

topics.headline: two accusatives under one exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception is expanded into a coordinated pair rather than stopping at mercy alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence directly marks the benefit noun as conjoined to the mercy noun by the conjunction.

topics.headline: coordination leaves specification available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second noun can be heard both as an equal coordinate and as the concrete expression of mercy's practical result.
topics.reason: The conjunction licenses coordination; specification remains a semantic possibility from order and noun relation, not a separate required parse.

topics.headline: mercy before usable outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ordered movement from mercy as cause to benefit as usable consequence, without turning the conjunction itself into a causal particle.
topics.reason: The local order supports a cause-to-outcome reading, while the grammar remains simple coordination.

words.gloss_range: usable provision, enjoyment, and practical benefit granted within a limited time, coordinated with mercy but immediately bounded by an endpoint phrase
words.root_gloss_range: benefit enjoyed and used, usable goods and provision, granted enjoyment or respite, and other construction-bound branches; the local noun selects practical temporary benefit, not every root branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source-marked mercy paired with the benefit
until an unspecified time, the endpoint of provision
unspecified time that closes the endpoint phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مَتَٰعًا}} ({{tr:matāʿan}}) turns survival into usable benefit, not merely an abstract blessing. Its root field supports enjoyment, use, goods, and granted respite, so the spared people become beneficiaries of a practical reprieve. The accusative noun also carries a bounded grant pressure, as though provision is being enacted, while local syntax keeps it coordinated with mercy. Yet the word is immediately governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:ilā ḥīnin}}): the benefit is real, but its expiration is made grammatically unavoidable. The phrase also joins a Quranic pattern of bounded worldly benefit (2:36, 7:24, 37:148), so maritime survival is heard as life granted for use until a term. Its matching accusative cadence with {{ar:رَحْمَةًۭ}} ({{tr:raḥmatan}}) balances the paired provisions before the sound moves toward the nasal close of {{ar:حِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḥīnin}}).

topics.headline: accusative provision with grant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun can carry the feel of an enacted grant, while local syntax still keeps it coordinated with mercy.
topics.reason: The local evidence secures coordination as the main parse; verbal-noun and Form I or Form II pressure can survive as grant coloring without requiring an explicit suppressed verb.

topics.headline: usable benefit rather than abstract blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reprieve becomes practical usable support, a benefit enjoyed and used within life rather than a generic blessing label.
topics.reason: V4 supports benefit enjoyed and used, usable goods, and prolonged benefit branches, and the local ship-survival frame licenses practical reprieve.

topics.headline: benefit receives the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the time limit lands on the usable benefit, so the reprieve is valuable and explicitly impermanent at the same time.
topics.reason: The endpoint prepositional phrase is syntactically tied to the benefit noun, making the limit grammatical rather than merely thematic.

topics.headline: bounded worldly benefit formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this temporary-benefit wording participates in a Quranic pattern of worldly life granted up to a term (2:36, 7:24, 37:148).
topics.reason: The row gives concrete references to the same bounded-benefit formula (2:36, 7:24, 37:148), so the echo survives as formulaic background without overriding the local ship context.

topics.headline: source to utility to endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause's movement: source-marked mercy, then usable benefit, then a temporal ceiling.
topics.reason: The sequence of local attachments supports the movement from source to coordinated benefit to governed endpoint.

topics.headline: paired provision sound and structure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the benefit balances the mercy noun in grammar and sound before the phrase turns toward temporal closure.
topics.reason: The two nouns are coordinated and share accusative indefinite form, supporting the structural and cadence pairing.

words.gloss_range: preposition of endpoint, here selecting a temporal limit for the provision rather than spatial direction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: usable provision that receives the endpoint
unspecified time governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) makes the benefit move toward an endpoint. With the governed time noun after it, the preposition selects temporal limit rather than place: the provision lasts until an unnamed term. Its placement after the benefit keeps the ceiling on provision, not directly on mercy, and the ayah lands on duration rather than permanence.

topics.headline: endpoint governs provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the temporal ceiling applies to the usable provision, while mercy itself is not given the same stated expiration.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says the time noun is governed by the preposition as the temporal limit of the benefit noun.

topics.headline: directional image narrowed to temporal deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time is pictured as a reachable boundary, even though the local grammar selects temporal deadline rather than spatial movement.
topics.reason: The governed time noun selects the temporal endpoint sense; the preposition's ordinary directional force survives only as image pressure.

topics.headline: reprieve lands on duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat is answered with reprieve, but the final structure sends that reprieve toward a temporal edge.
topics.reason: The preposition begins the final endpoint phrase, so the clause closes by imposing duration on the benefit.

words.gloss_range: an unspecified time or term, governed as the endpoint of provision and able to range from a moment or season to an appointed fatal limit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: usable temporary benefit answered by the endpoint
until, governing the time noun as endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:حِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḥīnin}}) closes the ayah with a real but undisclosed endpoint. Its genitive case is governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so time is not decorative; it is the limit placed on provision. But the indefinite ending withholds which time it is, allowing a moment, season, death, or larger appointed term to remain possible, with favorable season and fatal arrival both still in the word's range. The final word therefore resolves the drowning threat into survival while refusing to resolve the duration of that survival. Its final nasalized indefinite sound gives the ayah a phonetic stop that still matches the semantic openness of an unnamed time.

topics.headline: governed endpoint left unidentified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is grammatically real but referentially withheld, so the ayah ends in controlled uncertainty.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as genitive under the endpoint preposition, and its indefiniteness leaves the referent unresolved.

topics.headline: time range includes season and fatal term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can stretch from ordinary duration to the arrival of one's term, making time both neutral measure and possible threat.
topics.reason: The local noun remains an unspecified time; broader fatal and seasonal undertones survive as semantic range rather than a fixed identification of the endpoint.

topics.headline: bounded-reprieve recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint phrase participates in a recurring Quranic pattern of provision or earthly life bounded by a term (2:36, 7:24).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete recurrence references (2:36, 7:24), so the formula survives as inter-ayah background.

topics.headline: benefit answered by expiration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that temporary benefit and time complete each other: the spared life continues, but only under an unnamed term.
topics.reason: The endpoint noun is governed as the limit of the benefit, preserving the semantic pairing of benefit with expiration.

topics.headline: indefinite sound closes the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final indefinite sound matches the semantic openness of an unnamed time while still giving the ayah a closure point.
topics.reason: The noun's indefinite ending is both a grammatical marker and the final sound of the ayah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of رَحْمَةً with مَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tender beneficence takes material form as continued useful and enjoyable life, while the temporal phrase makes that continuance a bounded extension rather than an unconditional state.

activation_trace.role: Tenderness, care, and beneficence supply the protecting quality of the exception.
Useful or pleasurable benefit gives concrete content to the mercy.
Extended preservation makes the benefit durative and explicitly provisional.
A finite time-span bounds the preserved enjoyment.

changed_reading.before: Mercy and enjoyment are two loosely coordinated favors.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is the act of keeping a beneficial mode of life available for a limited interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا followed by the goal-like temporal limit إِلَىٰ حِينٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Matāʿ can be equipment or provision used to meet needs and attain sufficiency; paired with a temporal endpoint, it reads as what enables passage through an interim rather than as consumption for its own sake.

activation_trace.role: Goods, food, or equipment used for needs make the enjoyment function as passage-provision.
The time-span provides the horizon through which the provision must suffice.
Beneficence explains why the needed means remain available.

changed_reading.after: Matāʿ is an interim kit of sustenance and utility, mercifully supplied only as long as the passage requires.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The limiting construction إِلَىٰ حِينٍ and the terminal branch of ح ي ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same word that denotes a stretch of time can carry the shadow of destruction or death, so the mercy is a stay of a terminal event, not simply a quantity of extra time.

activation_trace.role: The arrival of death or destruction gives the temporal limit a terminal edge.
Prolonged preservation occupies the interval before that terminal edge.
Mercy functions as the force granting the stay.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is an unspecified neutral date.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is potentially the awaited terminal event from which mercy grants a temporary stay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The womb branch of رَحْمَةً joined to extended maintenance and an assigned time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The womb branch makes mercy imaginable as protective containment: life is maintained within a bounded environment until its due release-point.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies a containing and life-preserving spatial image for mercy.
Extended maintenance supplies the duration of containment.
An assigned time supplies a due endpoint rather than indefinite enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an abstract favorable disposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy is a timed holding-environment that preserves vulnerable life until release.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured lunar stages, return after departure, ordered non-overtaking, and a circular course turn the focus interval into an allotted trajectory. Matāʿ extends along that trajectory but does not outrun its measure.

activation_trace.role: Extension that reaches its limit makes benefit a course with a culmination.
Assigning a time converts the focus endpoint into a determined slot.
Measured magnitude reaching its boundary supplies the limit governing the lunar stages.
Return after departure makes temporal extension cyclical rather than indefinite.
Precedence and racing clarify that each course has an order it cannot violate.
Circular motion supplies the bounded track on which allotted duration unfolds.

structural_cues: 36:37-40 moves through stripping, running, measured stages, return, non-overtaking, and orbit immediately before the vessel sequence.
The repeated ordered motions make time visible as a governed course rather than an empty delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the luminaries move through measured, returning, non-overtaking courses. Reader: the focus interval is assigned the same course-like order. Alternative: the cosmic sequence may establish power and order without specifying the character of the later reprieve.

changed_reading.before: Until a time means only that benefit eventually stops.
changed_reading.after: Benefit runs through an allotted course whose measure, succession, and endpoint are already built into its extension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Carriage in a ship is exposed to engulfment; when neither a responding rescuer nor extraction from the predicament is available, the focus exception identifies mercy as the direct stay of drowning and matāʿ as continued passage while still afloat.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent care becomes the operative counterforce to the threatened drowning.
Preserved continuation names the extra span of passage granted instead of immediate engulfment.
The finite duration bounds how long the stay of danger lasts.
Bearing a visible load supplies the preservation-through-carriage mechanism.
The waterborne vessel supplies the material site in which continued safety occurs.
Literal drowning supplies the counterfactual outcome that mercy suspends.
Succor and response clarify the denied intermediary rescue.
Extraction from a predicament supplies the rescue operation explicitly unavailable before the exception.

structural_cues: 36:44 opens with an exception directly after 36:43's conditional drowning and doubled denial of help.
36:41-43 narrows from carriage in a vessel to the exact failure mode that the exception interrupts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: people are carried in a ship, may be drowned, and then have neither succor nor extraction. Reader: the exception makes their remaining afloat the mercy itself and their ongoing passage the matāʿ. Alternative: mercy may denote only rescue from one incident, while matāʿ begins a separate general grant.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is generic kindness added after danger.
changed_reading.after: The fact of still being carried rather than engulfed is mercy in operation, granting a bounded continuation of the voyage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence links hoped-for mercy to protective response, then stages a dispute over sending out allotted provision to feed another. The focus matāʿ therefore becomes an entrusted stock held during a grace-period, not merely private consumption.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence supplies both received care and the quality that can be extended toward others.
Goods and food used for needs make matāʿ available for social distribution.
The finite interval makes possession temporary and therefore accountable.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the responsive posture associated with receiving mercy.
The verbal recurrence turns mercy from a static possession into an outcome still to be received.
The outward movement of wealth supplies the circulation demanded of temporary goods.
Allotted gift marks the stock as received rather than absolutely owned.
Feeding another supplies the concrete use against which stewardship is tested.

structural_cues: 36:45 repeats the mercy root immediately after the focus, and 36:47 turns divine provision into a contested command to spend and feed.
36:46's refusal of signs between them keeps the interval open to either response or waste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy is sought through protective response, while allotted provision is to be spent in feeding. Reader: temporary matāʿ is a trust whose proper use participates in mercy. Alternative: the spending episode may be an independent moral test rather than an explanation of matāʿ.

changed_reading.before: The temporary benefit is primarily the recipient's private enjoyment.
changed_reading.after: The reprieve carries allotted, need-serving goods whose circulation toward others is part of how the interval is answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single alarming cry ends ordinary agency, the trumpet initiates rising, and a temporally fixed promise of the Merciful becomes the day of recompense. The focus hīn is thus a promised mode-change from temporary use to collective presentation and account.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged preservation names the temporary life-span that expires at the transition.
The terminal-event branch lets the time-limit carry death or destruction rather than neutral chronology.
A time assigned to an action makes the terminal transition appointed.
The frightening cry supplies the abrupt event that closes ordinary activity.
Sending air into the trumpet supplies the initiating signal for the next mode.
Rousing what was still supplies the transition from repose to collective movement.
A promise fixed to a time or place makes the endpoint scheduled rather than accidental.
The Merciful's recurrence at fulfillment keeps mercy present even as the reprieve ends.
The eventful severity of the day supplies the accountable state beyond the deadline.

structural_cues: 36:49-54 moves without recovery from one cry, to inability to make a testament or return home, to trumpet, rising, promise, presence, and recompense.
The mercy root at 36:52 prevents the deadline from being read as the disappearance of mercy; what ends is the temporary mode of benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one cry interrupts life, a trumpet raises the still, and the Merciful's timed promise becomes a day of account. Reader: this sequence specifies the focus hīn as expiry into a new collective mode. Alternative: the focus may retain a nearer personal or historical deadline rather than point specifically to this collective event.

changed_reading.before: The benefit lasts until an unspecified death or cutoff.
changed_reading.after: The benefit is a reprieve whose promised expiry transfers its recipients from temporary use into collective presence and account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later couples extension of life with reversal in created form. This makes matāʿ's prolongation a transforming life-course: added duration can carry the beneficiary into decline rather than preserving the same capacity unchanged.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged preservation supplies the added life-span under reconsideration.
Extension that reaches its extremity allows duration itself to culminate and turn.
The bounded span makes prolonged life a course with internal phases.
Life extended through time directly activates the prolongation branch of matāʿ.
Turning a thing upside down supplies the reversal produced within the extension.
Complete formed constitution supplies the bodily domain that is reversed.

structural_cues: 36:68 places prolonging life and reversing created form in one conditional relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: extended life is paired with reversal in bodily creation. Reader: the focus matāʿ includes this changing trajectory, so more time is mercy without guaranteeing stable powers. Alternative: 36:68 may illustrate creation independently of the maritime reprieve.

changed_reading.before: Temporary enjoyment is a stable benefit simply available for more time.
changed_reading.after: The granted extension is itself a changing life-course; mercy preserves life while its capacities may pass into reversal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a ship onto a womb through shared carrying, enclosure, vulnerable life, water, and timed release; it remains anchored in the explicit womb branch of the focus mercy-root and in packet branches for inner carrying, ship, semen-water, and creation. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a claim that the vessel or رَحْمَةً lexically means womb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The womb branch of رَحْمَةً together with maintained extension and an assigned حِين.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the focus-anchored image of protective containment.
Extended maintenance supplies preservation within the containing interval.
Assigned time supplies the due release-point of the analogy.
The inner pregnancy and fruit branch makes carrying descendants available as a gestational analogy.
The ship in water supplies the external vessel that carries vulnerable lineage.
Water ranging from drop to sea and including semen joins marine and generative material without equating them.
Bringing created life into existence supplies the developmental outcome of the containment.

changed_reading.before: The vessel merely transports already independent passengers, and mercy merely prevents an accident.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the vessel acts as an external womb: mercy carries and maintains a lineage through lethal water until a due emergence.

strongest_changes: The no-rescuer sequence makes continued flotation and carriage the operation of mercy itself.
Cosmic measures and the later single cry turn حِين into an allotted course ending in a promised collective transition.
The immediate mercy and provision episodes recast matāʿ as a temporary trust whose use includes protection, spending, and feeding.
The later aging reversal shows that extension preserves life without freezing its capacities.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the three focus nouns behave as one bounded preservation mechanism: mercy supplies the protecting force, matāʿ the usable and carried interval, and حِين its measured terminus. It also exposed a carefully containable vessel/womb analogy that the focus-only reading could not fully develop.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus حِين can still point to a personal death, a historical cutoff, or the collective blast; the packet strengthens the last without eliminating the others.
The stewardship reading depends on treating the 36:45-47 sequence as an explanation of reprieve rather than only a neighboring exhortation.
The external-womb model is a cross-domain material analogy and should not be promoted into lexical equivalence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mercy is the causal exception to drowning.** `ر ح م` B001 is mercy; `م ت ع` B001 benefit enjoyed and B007 prolonged keeping; `ح ي ن` B001 the due time of a thing. The exception follows the negation of rescue in 36:43 and then limits benefit to a term. The packet supplies exception and duration; I infer that mercy actively holds life out of an otherwise operative danger. The ayah reads as temporary preservation, not autonomous safety.
2. **Enjoyment is a timed trust.** `م ت ع` B003 is usable provision and `ح ي ن` B003 an assigned time. Later exact accounting (36:54) and animal benefits (36:71-73) place use inside responsibility. I infer that a fixed horizon turns enjoyment into entrusted use. The ayah preserves pleasure while denying permanence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:54's exact recompense corrected any reading of timed enjoyment as morally neutral delay: the preserved interval is usable provision whose uses remain attached to deeds.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Mercy is the temporal extension of a threatened carrying relation.** **ر ح م B001** anchors beneficent tenderness in **رَحْمَةً**; **م ت ع B007** anchors prolonged keeping for benefit in **مَتَٰعًا**; and **ح ي ن B001** supplies a due interval. Drowning and non-rescue precede in 36:43, and protective caution follows in 36:45. Those packet facts are supplied; the inferred arrow is *mercy holds the vulnerable system in operable suspension so benefit can continue until a boundary*. Mercy reads as maintained viability, not sentiment alone.
2. **The exception preserves benefit without abolishing termination.** **م ت ع B001** supplies enjoyed use, while **ح ي ن B002** activates the arrival of destruction as a secondary scope. The later local cry in 36:49 ends dispute and capacity in 36:50. The packet supplies respite and abrupt ending; the abduction is *extension postpones rather than cancels the destructive occasion*. **إِلَىٰ** makes mercy's gift explicitly bounded.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** The single cry in 36:49 identifies the otherwise unspecified boundary of **إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ**. Respite ends not by gradual exhaustion of benefit but by an event that seizes its users mid-occupation.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve, koyun veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanmasıyla; koyunda ise ayrıca şişmesiyle belirlenen durumdur. Bazı kullanımlar bunu doğum sonrasına bağlar. Koyunun doğumdan sonra yavru zarını atamaması da bu organ çevresindeki özel bir bozukluk olarak dala dahildir.

facets.statement: Dişi hayvan veya kadında döl yatağının ağrıması ya da hastalanması temel durumdur; özellikle bazı kullanımlarda bu durum doğum sonrasında görülür.

Koyun veya koyun sürüsünde döl yatağının şişmesi, hastalık durumunun özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, dişi deve, koyun veya kadının döl yatağında ağrı ya da hastalık bulunmasını temel alır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu özellikle doğum sonrasına bağlar. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki iki örnek de bir şeyin uygun zamanını bekleme veya o şeyi gerçekleşeceği zamana kadar gözleme çekirdeğinde birleşir. Geçici dal imgesi zaman, bekleme ve gözetme bileşenlerini doğru sınırlar.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin uygun zamanını beklemeyi ve gerçekleşmesini kollamayı bildirir.
Yemek zamanında içeri girmek için bekleyen kişi veya birini görmeyi bekleme bu çekirdeği örnekler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uygun zamanı bekleme ve beklenen şeyin gerçekleşmesini kollama çekirdeğini iki farklı durumla destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem zamanın gelmesini bekleme hem de beklenen olayın gerçekleşmesini gözetme bileşenlerini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Uygun zaman, bekleme ve gerçekleşmeyi kollama bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eyleme geçmeden önce elverişli zamanın gelmesini bekleme bağlamlarında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Elverişli zamanı bekleme ve zamanı gelince davranma yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda bekleyiş uygun zamana yöneliktir ve görme şartı yoktur; komşu dalda gözleme ve görsel gözetim belirgin bir bileşen olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin uygun zamanını kollamayı bildirir ve olumlu sonuç beklentisi gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi bir sonuca yönelik umut ve istek bileşenini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da henüz gerçekleşmemiş bir şeyi bekleme durumunu paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zamansal fırsatın gelmesini gözetir; komşu dal ise beklenen şeyin iyi olacağına ilişkin umudu anlamın zorunlu parçası yapar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi içki satılan yer, bu yere bağlanan içki adı ve genel dükkân adını birlikte aktarır; geçici dal imgesi bu öğeleri doğru sayar. Ancak dalın çıplak kök anlamı olduğu gösterilmediğinden, bunlar tek bir genel anlam gibi eritilmeden sınırlı bir söz kümesi olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içki satılan yer, ona bağlanan içki ve genel dükkân adlarıyla sınırlı bir söz kümesidir; genel satış veya içki kavramına bütünüyle yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak bir dal anlamı varsayılmaz; kaynakta birlikte verilen yer, dükkân ve bunlara bağlı içki kullanımları kendi sınırları içinde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, içki satılan bir yeri ve genel anlamda bir dükkânı adlandıran sözleri bir arada kapsar. Ayrıca böyle bir yere bağlanan içki adı da bu sınırlı söz kümesinde yer alır.

facets.statement: Satış yapılan genel bir dükkânı adlandıran bir kullanım içerir.
İçki satılan bir yeri adlandıran özel bir kullanım içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak, içki satılan yer ile genel dükkân adını ve yer adına bağlanan bir içki kullanımını birlikte aktarır. Bu öğeler ortak bir çıplak anlam varsayılmadan ayrı sınırlarıyla korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir dükkânı veya özellikle içki satılan yeri adlandırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dükkân veya içki satış yeri ölçeğindedir; komşu dal ise satıcıların ve malların toplandığı pazar alanını ve oradaki ticareti merkezine alır.
